That Brief facts of the case are that on 06.06.1997 in the morning the daughter of the informant Kumari Ram Rani aged about 10 years had gone for grazing pigs with Nanau son of Ram Harsh to Khabar Tal where accused Jageshwar son of Ram Das Lodh of village Mahakhera hamlet of Govindpur, Police Station Shivgarh was digging out Bhasorh for about for days and at about 12.00 noon, accused Jageshwar while dragging her daughter Kumari Ram Rani with ill intention and taking katta in his hand asked Nanau "Sale Bhag Jawo Nahi to Jan Se Mar Denge", then due to fear Nanau ran towards the village and in the way he met Raghubar son of Ram Lal and Haridwar son of Prabhu at the tubewell boring and told the entire fact and then they proceeded to the Khabartal and saw accused Jageshwar committing sexual intercourse upon kumari Ram Rani lying her on the ground and Kumari Ram Rani was crying and on the alarm raised by Nanau, Raghuwar and Haridwar, accused ran away from there threatening them to kill. Kumari Ram Rani became unconscious and Nanau had told about the occurrence to the informant at her house when the informant along with her family members reached at the Khabar Tal and saw her lying naked on the ground unconscious drenched with blood and when she regained consciousness she told the commission of sexual intercourse by the accused Jageshwar upon her forcibly on the point of Katta. 5.
